title: Can RPG Maker 2003 do DEF mods

posts.author: ZENWARECO
posts.body:
Can RPG Maker 2003 do, DEF x3 instead of DEF x2, or even x5. This I have no idea if it can even work.  I was doing a common event and I did this so far:
@> Conditional Branch: Switch [0165:Equipped] is ON
@> Conditional Branch: $h Mana Breastplate in Inventory
@>
: Else
@>
: Branch End
@>
: Else
@> Conditional Branch: [Rafiel] has [$h Mana Breastplate] equipped
@> Control Variables: [0020:Current Stat] = [Schorchasch]'s DEF
@> Control Variables: [0020:Current Stat] *= 3
@> Change Parameters: [Rafiel], DEF + Variable [0020]
@> Control Switches: [0165:Equipped] = ON
@>
: Else
@>
: Branch End
@>
: Branch End
and that is if a relic is equipped. :/  I made it so when it is, it multiplies the parameter once, though I guess the problem is how would it revert back to normal. when it isn't equipped. Trickery is needed here. :/
Or make some crazy like algorithm that multiplies defense like crazy when a skill is used?
Not sure if it can be done.
